mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, task_id, type, message, is_read) VALUES (#{userId}, #{taskId}, #{type}, #{message}, #{read})
mapper.select: SELECT n.*, tp.response_status FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN task_participants tp ON tp.task_id = n.task_id AND tp.user_id = n.user_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = false
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = true, read_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE notifications SET is_read = true, read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = false
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notifications WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
